caption: The drawing shows three views of an ornate metal object, rendered in shades of gold and brown, on a neutral beige background. The object appears to be a decorative door knocker or handle with symmetrical, elaborate scrollwork at the top and sides, and a pointed, ornamented base. The central section contains a geometric openwork design consisting of interlocking diamond shapes. The upper view shows the object from the front, highlighting the cut-out pattern and curved edges. The middle view shows the object from a front angle with a handle present, giving a sense of depth and curvature, and including two rounded protrusions on either side of the handle. The rightmost view is a side profile, illustrating the object’s thickness and the protruding handle, which is attached via a circular pivot. Below the main views, a scale is depicted, marked from 0 to 2 units. The artist’s name, P. Johnson, is written in the lower right corner.
title: Drawer Pull
